production.scenario: Uber Eats delivery telemetry arrives out of order, so payout and SLA analytics wait until stream completeness is believable.
components: global rider phones emitting pickup, handoff, and completion events on unreliable mobile links
service boundary that authenticates event producers and normalizes telemetry envelopes
control-plane service that estimates event-time completeness across many delivery partitions
durable authority in Kafka plus Iceberg tables for trip facts and corrected aggregates
computes courier pay, ETA adherence, and marketplace dashboards from stable windows
repair path that reopens windows when phones upload delayed events after reconnect
observability path for watermark skew, late data volume, and reopened windows
flows: Courier devices send event-time telemetry whenever the mobile network allows delivery.
The gateway forwards normalized records so the watermark service can estimate completeness.
Only events behind the current completeness frontier are committed as stable aggregates.
Payout and SLA jobs consume windows that the durable store marks as stable enough to use.
Late arrivals that land after window closure are queued for targeted recomputation.
The repair worker replays delayed trip events through the same watermark path to produce corrections.
Dashboards monitor watermark skew, out-of-order rate, and corrected payout volume.
